description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain reference functionality, including serialization, equality, comparison, and integrity checks within the Orleans distributed application framework. It specifically tests grain reference comparisons, JSON serialization/deserialization, passing references between grains, and internal behavior like hash code stability.

classes.name: GrainReferenceTest
classes.description: A test class focused on verifying behavior of grain references in Orleans, including comparison, equality, serialization, and passing references.

classes.name: GenericGrainReferenceHolder
classes.description: A serializable wrapper class holding a GrainReference, used for testing JSON serialization and deserialization of grain references within complex objects.

methods.name: TestGrainReferenceSerialization
methods.description: Helper method to test serialization/deserialization of grain references with optional pre-serialization resolution.

methods.name: NewtonsoftJsonSerializeRoundtrip
methods.description: Helper method performing JSON serialization and deserialization round-trip using Newtonsoft.Json.
